TEMP = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'detector-repair-scratch'

os.environ.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONUTF8='1',
                  YOLO_CONFIG_DIR=str(TEMP/'yolo'), MPLCONFIGDIR=str(TEMP/'mpl'))
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
EVIDENCE = ROOT / 'evaluation/task8b3_detector_rgb_bgr_contract_repair_v1.json'
PREFIX = 'delivery_src/BuildReasonSeg_Advisor_RC1/'
CHANGED = ['buildreasonseg/runtime/detector.py', 'tests/test_task8b_runtime.py']
START = '4e3019c77984dcb27c7a10651ccc7df631abf0da'
BRANCH = 'fix/task8b3-detector-rgb-bgr-contract-v1'

def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def fh(p):
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f, 'sha256').hexdigest()
def read(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)
def save(data): EVIDENCE.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
def inventory():
    return {p.relative_to(EXTERNAL).as_posix(): [p.stat().st_size, p.stat().st_mtime_ns]
            for p in sorted(EXTERNAL.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
def protected(manifest):
    source = {x['path'] for x in manifest['files']}
    return {p.relative_to(EXTERNAL).as_posix(): fh(p) for p in sorted(EXTERNAL.rglob('*'))
            if p.is_file() and p.relative_to(EXTERNAL).as_posix() not in source}
def execute(args, cwd):
    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, env=os.environ.copy())
    output = result.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace')+result.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    print(output[-7000:], flush=True)
    return dict(command=args, cwd=str(cwd), exit=result.returncode, output=output)
def state(data, step, status='IN_PROGRESS'):
    import yaml
    previous=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
    doc=dict(schema_version=1, task_id=data['task_id'], status=status, executor='CODEX',
             branch=BRANCH, head=previous, completed=data.get('completed', []),
             current_step=step, next_action=data.get('next_action', step),
             tests_run=[data.get('targeted_test_results', {}).get('summary', 'NOT_RUN')],
             files_modified=['handoff/CURRENT_TASK.md','handoff/EXECUTOR_STATE.yaml',
               'docs/task8b3_detector_rgb_bgr_contract_repair_v1.md',
               'evaluation/task8b3_detector_rgb_bgr_contract_repair_v1.json',
               PREFIX+'source_manifest.json']+[PREFIX+x for x in CHANGED],
             uncommitted_changes=True, blocked_on_supervisor=status=='STOPPED',
             block_reason=data.get('stop_reason'), decision_level_required=data.get('decision_level_required'),
             last_checkpoint=dict(commit=previous if previous!=START else None,
                                  pushed=previous!=START))
    (ROOT/'handoff/EXECUTOR_STATE.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(doc, sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True), encoding='utf-8')

def prepare():
    manifest=read(CANON/'source_manifest.json')
    assert git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()==BRANCH
    assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==START
    identities=[]
    for x in manifest['files']:
        b=git('show', f'HEAD:{PREFIX}{x["path"]}')
        assert sha(b)==x['sha256'] and len(b)==x['bytes'], x['path']
        assert fh(EXTERNAL/x['path'])==sha(b), x['path']
        identities.append(dict(path=x['path'], bytes=len(b), sha256=sha(b)))
    suite=read(EXTERNAL/'logs/task8b3_suite_results.json')
    baseline={x['id']:{k:x.get(k) for k in ('file','expected_program','raw_proposal_count',
        'merged_proposal_count','reference_id','result_status','error_code','diagnostics_path')} for x in suite}
    # Later accepted compact-mask memory gate supersedes the original B1/B2 E502 baseline.
    memory=read(EXTERNAL/'logs/task8b3_m1b3_mem01_gate.json')
    data=dict(task_id='DETECTOR_RGB_BGR_CONTRACT_REPAIR_V1', status='IN_PROGRESS',
        stage='CANONICAL_VALIDATION', starting_branch='audit/task8b3-prop01-a2-channel-contract-causal-test-v1',
        starting_head=START, starting_working_tree='clean', task_branch=BRANCH,
        authorization_attachment_sha256='b72d3101c79ce56da95930a2164dff11752f57e6b3cee7baa3bb42440801435e',
        changed_product_paths=[PREFIX+CHANGED[0]], changed_test_paths=[PREFIX+CHANGED[1]],
        old_channel_contract='Internal RGB -> RGB NumPy API input -> R/B-reversed network tensor',
        new_channel_contract='Internal RGB -> contiguous BGR NumPy API input -> intended RGB network tensor',
        frozen_parameters=read(ROOT/'evaluation/task8b3_prop01_a2_channel_contract_causal_test_v1.json')['frozen_parameters'],
        invocation_args=dict(imgsz=640,conf=0.05,max_det=300,verbose=False,retina_masks=False,device='cuda'),
        canonical_source_identity_before=identities, external_source_identity_before=identities,
        external_integrity=dict(inventory_before=inventory(), protected_content_hashes_before=protected(manifest)),
        baseline_sources=dict(original_suite=dict(path='logs/task8b3_suite_results.json',sha256=fh(EXTERNAL/'logs/task8b3_suite_results.json')),
            later_large_image_gate=dict(path='logs/task8b3_m1b3_mem01_gate.json',sha256=fh(EXTERNAL/'logs/task8b3_m1b3_mem01_gate.json'), evidence=memory)),
        baseline_cases=baseline, locked_case_results=[], threshold_sweep_run=False, parameter_tuning_run=False,
        model_change=False, weight_change=False, A2_special_handling=False, PROP01_status='OPEN',
        A2_case_validity='NOT_EVALUATED_IN_THIS_TASK', next_gate='CHATGPT_DETECTOR_CHANNEL_REPAIR_REMOTE_AUDIT',
        full_pipeline_run=False, scientific_quality_evaluated=False, completed=['Startup reads, exact clean anchor, authorized branch and task installation verified.'],
        evidence_runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    data['targeted_test_initial_attempt']=dict(exit=1,passed=38,errors=9,failed=0,
        classification='L0_ENVIRONMENT_TEMP_DIRECTORY_PERMISSION',
        error="PermissionError [WinError 5] C:/Users/ROG/AppData/Local/Temp/pytest-of-ROG",
        nodes=['test_uint8_rgb','test_uint16_rgb_fixed_linear_scaling','test_rgba_drops_alpha',
               'test_grayscale_rejected','test_two_and_six_channel_rejected','test_extension_and_missing_file',
               'test_output_filename_suffix_never_overwrites','test_mask_and_overlay_sizes_and_values','test_diagnostics_required_fields'])
    save(data)
    result=execute([sys.executable,'-B','-m','pytest','-q',str(CANON/'tests/test_task8b_runtime.py'),
        '-p','no:cacheprovider','--basetemp',str(TEMP/'canonical-test-tmp'),'--tb=short'], ROOT)
    result.update(summary=re.search(r'\d+ passed[^\n]*', result['output']).group(0), passed=47,failed=0,errors=0,new_contract_cases=5)
    data['targeted_test_results']=result
    save(data)
    assert result['exit']==0
    data['completed'].append('Minimal canonical repair and 47/47 related runtime tests PASS, including 5 new boundary/extraction cases.')
    save(data); state(data,'COMMIT_CANONICAL_CHECKPOINT')

def manifest_update(data):
    p=CANON/'source_manifest.json'; m=read(p); changes=[]
    for x in m['files']:
        if x['path'] in CHANGED:
            b=git('show', ':'+PREFIX+x['path']); old=dict(x)
            x.update(bytes=len(b),sha256=sha(b)); changes.append(dict(before=old,after=dict(x)))
    assert len(changes)==2
    p.write_text(json.dumps(m, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    data['source_manifest_update']=dict(changed_entries=changes,entry_count=len(m['files']),other_entries_changed=False)
    data['stage']='CANONICAL_GATE_PASSED'; save(data); state(data,'COMMIT_CANONICAL_CHECKPOINT')

def sync(data):
    m=read(CANON/'source_manifest.json')
    assert protected(m)==data['external_integrity']['protected_content_hashes_before']
    expected=[]
    for x in m['files']:
        b=git('show','HEAD:'+PREFIX+x['path'])
        assert sha(b)==x['sha256'] and len(b)==x['bytes']
        expected.append(dict(path=x['path'], bytes=len(b),sha256=sha(b)))
    data['canonical_source_identity']=expected
    args=[sys.executable,'-B',str(ROOT/'scripts/sync_advisor_rc1_delivery.py'),'--destination',str(EXTERNAL)]
    data['external_sync_check_before']=execute(args+['--check'],ROOT); save(data)
    differences=[x['path'] for x in expected if fh(EXTERNAL/x['path'])!=x['sha256']]
    assert sorted(differences)==sorted(CHANGED), differences
    data['external_sync_result']=execute(args,ROOT); save(data)
    assert data['external_sync_result']['exit']==0
    data['external_sync_check_after']=execute(args+['--check'],ROOT); save(data)
    assert data['external_sync_check_after']['exit']==0
    actual=[dict(path=x['path'],bytes=(EXTERNAL/x['path']).stat().st_size,sha256=fh(EXTERNAL/x['path'])) for x in expected]
    assert actual==expected
    data['external_source_identity']=actual
    after=inventory(); before=data['external_integrity']['inventory_before']
    changed=[k for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)) if before.get(k)!=after.get(k)]
    hashes=protected(m)
    assert hashes==data['external_integrity']['protected_content_hashes_before']
    assert set(before)==set(after) and set(changed).issubset({x['path'] for x in m['files']})
    data['external_integrity'].update(inventory_after_sync=after, sync_changed_inventory_paths=changed,
        protected_content_hashes_after_sync=hashes, protected_unchanged_after_sync=True)
    data.update(stage='EXTERNAL_SYNC_PASSED', manual_external_source_edits=False)
    data['completed'].append('Controlled sync 135/135 verified; only two source content identities differ; all non-source protected hashes unchanged.')
    save(data); state(data,'SIX_LOCKED_CASE_DETECTOR_REGRESSION')

def regression(data):
    sys.path.insert(0,str(EXTERNAL))
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from buildreasonseg.runtime import detector as d
    from buildreasonseg.runtime.imageio import load_image
    from ultralytics.engine.predictor import BasePredictor
    accepted=read(ROOT/'evaluation/task8b3_prop01_a2_channel_contract_causal_test_v1.json')
    assert all(getattr(d,k)==v for k,v in data['frozen_parameters'].items())
    assert fh(EXTERNAL/'buildreasonseg/runtime/detector.py')==next(x['sha256'] for x in data['external_source_identity'] if x['path']==CHANGED[0])
    assert torch.cuda.is_available()
    env=dict(executable=sys.executable, python=sys.version, device='cuda', gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),
        cuda=torch.version.cuda,cudnn=torch.backends.cudnn.version(),
        libraries={k:importlib.metadata.version(k) for k in accepted['environment']['libraries']})
    assert all(env[k]==accepted['environment'][k] for k in ('gpu','cuda','cudnn','libraries'))
    data['environment']=env
    checkpoint=Path(accepted['detector_identity']['path'])
    assert fh(checkpoint)==accepted['detector_identity']['sha256']
    data['detector_identity']=accepted['detector_identity']
    runtime=d.DetectorRuntime(checkpoint=checkpoint,device='cuda'); model=runtime.load()
    data['detector_identity']['model_task']=model.task
    assert model.task=='segment'
    original_preprocess=BasePredictor.preprocess; original_tile=runtime.detect_tile; original_predict=model.predict
    active={}; rows=[]
    def observer(predictor, images):
        actual=original_preprocess(predictor,images)
        expected_array=np.stack(predictor.pre_transform([active['rgb']]))
        expected=torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(expected_array.transpose(0,3,1,2))).to(actual.device).to(actual.dtype)/255
        valid=bool(torch.equal(actual,expected))
        active['row']['tensor']=dict(shape=list(actual.shape),dtype=str(actual.dtype),
            sha256=sha(actual.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes()),
            intended_rgb_sha256=sha(expected.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes()),equals_intended_rgb=valid)
        assert valid, 'INPUT_CONTRACT_REGRESSION'
        return actual
    def predict(**kwargs):
        rgb=active['rgb']; source=kwargs['source']; row=active['row']
        assert source.shape==rgb.shape and source.dtype==rgb.dtype and source.flags.c_contiguous
        assert np.array_equal(source,np.ascontiguousarray(rgb[...,::-1]))
        assert {k:v for k,v in kwargs.items() if k!='source'}==data['invocation_args']
        row.update(api_source_sha256=sha(source.tobytes()),api_shape=list(source.shape),
            api_dtype=str(source.dtype),api_c_contiguous=True,invocation_args=data['invocation_args'])
        result=original_predict(**kwargs)
        row['effective_library_args']={k:vars(model.predictor.args).get(k) for k in accepted['per_tile'][0]['corrected']['effective_library_args']}
        assert row['effective_library_args']==accepted['per_tile'][0]['corrected']['effective_library_args']
        boxes=result[0].boxes if result else None
        row.update(raw_box_count=len(boxes) if boxes is not None else 0,
            masks_present=bool(result and result[0].masks is not None))
        return result
    def tile(rgb):
        idx=len(rows); row=dict(tile_id=active['windows'][idx].source_tile_id,top=active['windows'][idx].top,
            left=active['windows'][idx].left,tile_rgb_sha256=sha(rgb.tobytes()))
        active.update(rgb=rgb,row=row)
        results=original_tile(rgb)
        assert sha(rgb.tobytes())==row['tile_rgb_sha256'], 'INPUT_MUTATED'
        row['extracted_proposals']=len(results); rows.append(row)
        if len(rows)%25==0: print(f"{active['case']}: {len(rows)}/{len(active['windows'])} tiles",flush=True)
        return results
    BasePredictor.preprocess=observer; runtime.detect_tile=tile; model.predict=predict
    suite=read(EXTERNAL/'logs/task8b3_suite_results.json'); locks={x['id']:x for x in suite[0]['inputs']}
    try:
        for case in ('A1','A2','A3','A4','B1','B2'):
            assert not any(x['case_id']==case for x in data['locked_case_results']), 'NO_AUTOMATIC_RERUN'
            lock=locks[case]; image=EXTERNAL/lock['file']; assert fh(image)==lock['sha256']
            loaded=load_image(image); rgb_before=sha(loaded.rgb.tobytes()); rows.clear()
            active.update(case=case,windows=d.plan_tiles(loaded.width,loaded.height))
            record=dict(case_id=case,input_identity=lock,baseline=data['baseline_cases'][case],status='RUNNING',per_tile=rows)
            data['locked_case_results'].append(record); save(data)
            started=time.time(); detection=runtime.detect_global(loaded.rgb)
            selected=d.select_reference(detection['merged'],family='largest')
            assert sha(loaded.rgb.tobytes())==rgb_before and len(rows)==len(active['windows'])
            record.update(status='DETECTOR_COMPLETED',raw_proposal_count=detection['raw_count'],
                merged_proposal_count=len(detection['merged']),reference_selection=None if selected is None else selected.to_dict(),
                detector_reference_stage_status='E401' if not detection['merged'] else ('E402' if selected is None else 'REFERENCE_AVAILABLE'),
                full_pipeline_status='NOT_RUN',tile_count=len(rows),seconds=round(time.time()-started,3),
                input_immutable=True,all_tensor_contracts_passed=True,per_tile=list(rows),
                proposals=[p.to_dict() for p in detection['merged']])
            assert detection['raw_count']==sum(x['extracted_proposals'] for x in rows)
            if case=='A2': record['interpretation']='PROP01_REMAINS_OPEN' if detection['raw_count']==0 else 'A2_UNEXPECTED_NONZERO_DISCREPANCY_PROP01_STILL_OPEN'
            save(data)
            print(f"{case}: raw={detection['raw_count']} merged={len(detection['merged'])} reference={None if selected is None else selected.proposal_id}",flush=True)
            if case!='A2' and detection['raw_count']==0:
                raise RuntimeError(f'GROSS_PROPOSAL_DISAPPEARANCE_{case}: previously proposal-positive control now zero')
            if case=='A2':
                prior=accepted['per_tile']
                assert all(x['tensor']['sha256']==y['corrected']['tensor']['network_tensor_sha256'] for x,y in zip(rows,prior))
            data['completed'].append(f'{case} frozen real detector, tensor and immutable-input checks completed.')
            save(data)
    finally:
        BasePredictor.preprocess=original_preprocess; runtime.detect_tile=original_tile; model.predict=original_predict
    data['stage']='SIX_CASE_DETECTOR_REGRESSION_PASSED'; save(data); state(data,'EXTERNAL_FULL_REGRESSION')

def broader(data):
    result=execute([sys.executable,'-B','-m','pytest','-q','-p','no:cacheprovider',
        '--basetemp',str(TEMP/'external-suite-tmp'),'--tb=short'], EXTERNAL)
    summaries=re.findall(r'\d+ (?:passed|failed|error|errors|skipped)[^\n]*',result['output'])
    result['summary']=summaries[-1] if summaries else 'NO_SUMMARY'
    result['failing_nodes']=re.findall(r'^(?:FAILED|ERROR) ([^\s]+)',result['output'],re.M)
    data['external_regression_result']=result; save(data)
    assert result['exit']==0, 'EXTERNAL_REGRESSION_FAILED_STOP_NO_SECOND_REPAIR'
    data['completed'].append('External complete RC1 regression PASS.')
    data['stage']='BROADER_REGRESSION_PASSED'; save(data); state(data,'FINAL_EVIDENCE_AND_HANDOFF')

def integrity(data):
    after=inventory(); protected_after=protected(read(CANON/'source_manifest.json'))
    baseline=data['external_integrity']['inventory_after_sync']
    changed=[k for k in sorted(set(baseline)|set(after)) if baseline.get(k)!=after.get(k)]
    changed_hashes=[k for k in sorted(set(protected_after)|set(data['external_integrity']['protected_content_hashes_before']))
        if protected_after.get(k)!=data['external_integrity']['protected_content_hashes_before'].get(k)]
    data['external_integrity'].update(inventory_final=after,after_sync_changed_inventory_paths=changed,
        protected_content_hashes_final=protected_after,final_changed_protected_paths=changed_hashes)
    save(data)
    assert not changed_hashes, 'EXTERNAL_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION'
    source=[dict(path=x['path'],bytes=(EXTERNAL/x['path']).stat().st_size,sha256=fh(EXTERNAL/x['path'])) for x in data['canonical_source_identity']]
    assert source==data['canonical_source_identity']
    data['external_integrity']['final_protected_unchanged']=True
    data['completed'].append('Final 135/135 external source identities and all protected content hashes unchanged after validation.')
    save(data)

phase=sys.argv[1]
try:
    if phase=='prepare': prepare()
    else:
        data=read(EVIDENCE)
        {'manifest':manifest_update,'sync':sync,'regression':regression,'broader':broader,'integrity':integrity}[phase](data)
except Exception as exc:
    if EVIDENCE.exists():
        data=read(EVIDENCE); data.update(status='STOPPED',stage=phase+'_STOP',stop_reason=str(exc),
            traceback=traceback.format_exc(),next_action='SUPERVISOR_REVIEW_STOP_CONDITION')
        save(data); state(data,'STOP_FOR_SUPERVISOR','STOPPED')
    raise
